title: Kisir
subtitle: Turkish bulgur wheat salad with pomegranate molasses
excerpt: Fine bulgur wheat mixed with tomato paste, pomegranate molasses, and masses of fresh herbs. Sharp and bright. Best eaten the same day it is made.
sourceNotes: Turkish kisir, a classic meze and picnic dish. The pomegranate molasses and tomato paste combination gives the characteristic deep, sour flavour.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Make up to 4 hours ahead and keep covered at room temperature. Add the herbs just before serving.

content.text: Kisir is a Turkish bulgur salad that relies on the balance of tomato paste and pomegranate molasses. Get that balance right and everything else falls into place. The herbs must be generous and the salad should taste sharp.
Put the bulgur wheat in a large bowl. Pour over 300ml of boiling water. Cover with a plate and leave to soak for 15 minutes until the water is absorbed and the grains are tender.
Fluff the bulgur with a fork. Add the tomato puree and olive oil while the bulgur is still warm. Mix well so the paste coats every grain.
Add the pomegranate molasses and lemon juice. Stir again. Taste for seasoning. The mix should taste quite sharp and savoury at this stage.
Once the bulgur has cooled to room temperature, add the diced tomato, spring onion, cucumber, parsley, mint, chilli flakes, and sumac.
Mix well and taste again. Adjust the lemon juice, pomegranate molasses, or salt as needed. The salad should taste bright and sharp, not bland.
Serve at room temperature, spread across a wide plate. It is traditionally eaten with cos lettuce leaves for scooping.

items.symptom: The bulgur is still crunchy after soaking.
items.cause: The water was not hot enough, or not enough water was used.
items.fix: Pour over freshly boiled water and cover tightly. Leave for a full 15 minutes without lifting the lid.

items.cause: Not enough acid or the pomegranate molasses was too mild.
items.fix: Add more lemon juice and a little extra pomegranate molasses. Taste as you go.

items.cause: The tomato and cucumber released too much water into the mix.
items.fix: Salt and drain the diced tomato and cucumber for 10 minutes before adding, then pat dry.
